reviews.text:
I called to schedule an appointment to have my bunny neutered, but unfortunately, the experience was extremely frustrating and unprofessional.

The person I spoke with wanted to create a new file for me. Despite spelling my surname multiple times, she repeatedly asked me to spell it again. When I finally asked her what she had entered as my surname so far, she admitted that she hadn't typed it in at all.

I find this level of carelessness and lack of attention to detail concerning. If something as simple as recording a client's surname is handled so poorly, it makes me question how attentive the staff would be when caring for my pet.

This experience left me with very little confidence in the clinic, and I would not feel comfortable entrusting my bunny's care to them.
Excellent care !!
Natalie and Caitlin were awesome very patient with my Callie, I really thought Callie was going to be sedated, but those young ladies had the best energy and that made such a big difference Thank you
The staff is nice and Dr. Cynthia is incredibly friendly and knowledgeable. I know our pets are in good hands 💗

Dr Jenny is awesome dr. She is very kind
And attentive very Gentle with my Sunshine bird. Very knowledgeable
We’re grateful for your 5-star review, Kevin! It’s wonderful to know you had a great experience. We look forward to your next visit!
We appreciate the 5-star review, Saul! It's great to know you had a wonderful visit at our clinic. We hope to welcome you and your pet back in the future!
Thanks for the top rating, Tobias! We're happy to know you enjoyed your time with us. We can't wait to see you and your pet again!
Thank you for the 5-star rating, Jennifer! We're glad to know you had a positive experience with us at the clinic. We look forward to seeing you and your pet again soon!
Super good at taking care of our cats!
Thanks for the 5 stars, Mallory! We're happy to have met your expectations. Hope to welcome you and your pet back soon!
The staff and doctors always take great care of my bunny and provide compassionate and professional service!
Excellent for regular pets and small exotic pets as well.

Scheduling was easy. Warm welcoming staff. My dog loved her vet which I did not expect, and I appreciated the doctor's clarity in communicating, and listening. It’s a comfortable office space, and they are efficient with it while also being careful and thorough, and genuinely demonstrate care.

I take my Russian Tortoise here. There are not a lot of reptile vets in Chicago as far as I can see. They are nice and seem to truly care about animals rather. They do beak and nail trimmings for tortoises. To board your pet, you have to do a physical and obtain some samples for testing.
Thank you for the excellent rating! We're delighted to have provided you with a positive experience at our clinic.
Animal House of Chicago cares for all pets including exotics.  They are professional, competent, great with the pets and I wish they were my doctors.
JJ was well taken care of and let us know he didn’t have any complaints.  Staff was friendly and informed us what he ate.
Staff was friendly, caring & knowledgeable
Ernesto, we appreciate the 5-star review! It's great to know you enjoyed your visit.

The team is so wonderful. They take a lot of time to answer my questions because I'm an overly worried Ferret Father. They actually care and don't just churn me through the system the way i felt at Midwest B&E. They are worth paying a little extra more for peace of mind and personal attention to your pet. It really does feel like family here
Hi Cassie! Thank you so much for the stars. We are thrilled we get to have such wonderful clients like you!

Dr. Cynthia is an absolute gem. She's caring, attentive, and professional. When we had to let go of our 19 year old cat, Winston, I felt supported by Dr. Cynthia and the team during that very difficult time. She is now the vet of our newly adopted cat that happens to have a very different temperament than Winston. She patiently listened while I asked many questions about grooming and other issues of concern. I trust my cat with Animal House and appreciate their care and professionalism.

Really friendly and knowledgeable staff at every position. It’s very clear that they genuinely care about the pets they see. Dr. Jenny in particular is incredibly compassionate to me and my pet, I would recommend her and this vet to all pet owners!

When the moment arrived to bid farewell to Sherman, our beloved conure of 31 years, the extraordinary staff at Animal House of Chicago promptly responded to our emergency with their characteristic kindness, gentleness, and empathy.

We were taken to a quiet, private room, where the vet clearly explained what was about to happen and offered to discuss financial options with us. Then we were left alone to say goodbye to Sherman.

It brings us immense comfort to know that our precious bird died peacefully in the very place he received loving care over the many years that he was both a patient and frequent boarder. Sherman truly enjoyed his time there.

We extend our heartfelt gratitude to the compassionate team at Animal House of Chicago, and we wholeheartedly recommend them to those who are seeking exceptional care for their treasured pet, whether it is living a full life or approaching the end.

Karen Manchester and Jack Brown

Tried Nile’s animal hospital

About money
I went back to animal house of chgo
I was welcomed back just like family
My bird was very happy to be back too

When the moment arrived to bid farewell to our beloved conure of 31 years, the extraordinary staff at Animal House of Chicago promptly responded to our emergency with their characteristic kindness, gentleness, and empathy.
We were taken to a quiet, private room, where the vet clearly explained the process of what was about to happen and offered to discuss financial options. Then we were left alone to say our final goodbyes.

Professional, knowledgeable, friendly, and caring. All the things you want from the folks taking care of your beloved animal friends.
Thank you, Lisa, for your generous 5-star rating! We truly value your support and are delighted to hear that you had a positive experience.

Simply put Animal House of Chicago is a happy place. The staff seems to love their job and they treat their clients with respect and kindness. Whether I’m there for my pet’s yearly check up or for boarding, I’m very confident that my pet will be well taken care of, and she always is!

I am so happy with Animal House of Chicago.  We have struggled to find a consistent vet for the last decade and I’m so happy that we finally found this place.  Both doctors we have met have been so experienced, kind, and attentive.  Both my dog and a guinea pig have been patients here and they have been the most knowledgeable and competent doctors I have found for both animals.  Last week our dog Franny had eye surgery at Animal House.  She had both of her eyes removed and Dr. Kim did an amazing job with the surgery.  Franny’s incisions are healing so nicely.  Her eyes just look neatly closed now, because Dr. Kim was able to stitch them up in a cascaded way that look like it is just her eyelids.  Really incredible.  I loved that this clinic was able to diagnose and perform the surgery right there and for a reasonable price.  The staff was great about checking in on us and were so patient as we struggled with aftercare.  I could tell they really loved my dog and that made such a difference.  I don’t usually write reviews but I felt compelled in this case after such a positive experience.  I definitely recommend this vet!
Thank you, Susan! We appreciate you and love your fur babies!

Thank you, Daniela, for your 5-star rating! We're grateful for your feedback and delighted to know that you had a positive experience with us. Your support inspires us to keep pushing forward with determination!

The only reason this place loses two stars is because of the cost. Exam + 3 year vaccines for each cat is $432. I thought it felt high but chalked it up to prices increasing (like everything else) since the last time we did an exam at a different clinic a few years back.

So, feeling slightly disgruntled, I asked a friend who uses the nearby Ravenswood Animal Hospital how much they cost...and it was $270 for exactly the same thing (exam + 3 yr vaccines). I also dug a little and found they are part of a large network called Vetcor. Not sure if the large network is part of the cost difference, but the price comparison isn't even close (46% more expensive!).

With that being said, the front desk was super nice and the veterinarian who saw us was wonderful. I have nothing negative to say about the folks working inside, just the noncompetitive pricing of the business.
The only vet I’ve ever been to that refuses to send prescriptions directly to Chewy.
Thank you, Sierra, for your 5-star rating! We appreciate your support and are delighted to know that your experience with us met your expectations!
Great vet docs and staff.
Thank you so much for your review, Natalie. We look forward to seeing you and your pet next time!

Was good. Took my rabbits in and cleared the ear mites. But they charged me for nail clipping and didn’t do it. Also Cocoa has a lot of new scabs on her ears but yet, no word. Just, give us money. Joke construct.
Pam, we are grateful you took the time to leave a review. Thank you for trusting us with your pet’s care!
Alex, thank you for your review and for trusting our team! We are here whenever you and your pet need us.

I don’t know what I would have done without the amazing care of the veterinarians at this facility. They really show up for you and your pet. Not like other vets where it’s clearly all about making money. These people genuinely care.

All in all, some mixed feelings. My cat is doing noticeably better after his tooth surgery, so I’m very grateful to AHOC and the surgeons did a great job. I just have some mixed feelings about two other things. One, the surgery cost $1800. I believe vets in the suburbs will charge much less if you are on a tight budget. Years ago, ~2k would have been astronomical. I’m truly not sure what price is considered normal anymore. Two, the staff gave us antibiotics and told us it was really important to administer them. In the moment we just wanted to get our cat out of there so we paid for all the medication they recommended. We got home and found out online that most vets nowadays regard antibiotic prescription post dental surgery that fully closes up the gums as an outdated practice. We discontinued the antibiotics and our cat healed with no issues. These two factors together make me wonder what else we were overcharged for, or what other unnecessary or outdated things were done. Again, I’m really grateful to these doctors for giving my cat his energy and life back. And the staff are really nice and prompt to respond. People are noticing that venture capital is trying to make money off of pet care, and there is a yelp review of this place that mentions this. This is not the first vet hospital that has overcharged us for medications and I’m sure it won’t be the last even if we switch vets, so we may stick with this place anyway. Sigh…
We're glad had a 5-star experience. Thank you for sharing! We look forward to seeing you next time.
Thank you, Searphine, for your 5-star rating! We're glad to hear that your experience with us met your expectations. Your trust is important to us, and we’re committed to maintaining that standard.

I have the utmost respect, admiration and appreciation for the staff at this wonderful place.  I recently had to experience end of life for my 18 yo kitty.  The entire experience was of course heartbreaking, however everyone there could not have been better.  They were compassionate in the best of ways without being super sappy, they were incredibly supportive and incredibly respectful.  I cannot thank them enough.
I recommend them without question.

Thank you!  And my DeeDee would thank you for the way you handled her if she could..

Ive taken both of my Gerbils here and this time was a more dire situation and the team was able to get me an opening that Monday as well as gave me helpful advice in the meantime. They also let me take both of the boys in together as their a bonded pair, to prevent them from anxiety/stress; which was beyond appreciated and shows they not only care about the physical health but mental and emotional too!
I took my Gerbil Jake in for a mass and Dr.Kim took phenomenal care of him. She was honest and compassionate when she had an idea of what was wrong and gave me her honest advice for the next steps. I was a mess over my little guy and she was beyond compassionate and kept reassuring throughout the visit. I could never thank her enough.
Shes an awesome Veterinarian that seriously seems to care about what she does! She not only made my tiny gerbils feel cared for but myself as-well. 10/10 would recommend her for your animals as she understands they're not just animals and that they’re family as-well❤️🐾.

I just called them before 6pm with some general questions, the receptionist told me she goes home at 6 so make it quick. Then the same rep told me they are booked for the next couple of weeks. So I asked her, so you do not take any animals, emergency, none emergency none whatsoever. The same rep said we take some but we decide who is using our services. Then the office manager who was present talked to me and said for the general public we do not take any animals for treatment. We take some selectively but only from friends and people who we know.
Well that was shocking to hear from a Veterinary clinic doing business in Chicago to be open only to selective clients not every one who has an ill pet and want Veterinary services in Chicago and is able to pay for services rendered. That sounds to me very biased if not outright racist. I asked the office manager what criteria should I have to qualify to bring my animal to Animal House for treatment to be accepted, she cut me off saying looks like you should find another Veterinary Clinic. Veterinary Clinic doing business in Chicago should provide services to all Chicago residents not only those who they determine meet their exclusive membership criteria. To me it looks like taking care of pets and treating sick animals is the last on their minds and the list of their priorities. It is not the pet, animal in distress it is how much money that potential client will pay us that counts in long term.

That is why Veterinary Clinic Animal House Hospital tells people looking for Veterinary services for their sick pets to call in four weeks or even months in advance to book an appointment for your sick pet TODAY.
It is absolutely appalling and outrageous for a Veterinary Clinic licensed in Chicago to openly display such disregard for welfare and health of Chicago residents pets.
I hope City of Chicago looks more deeply into business practices of Animal House Hospital as a Vererinary Clinic licensed and doing business in Chicago.

We saw Dr Kim for our first visit and Dr Jenny for our follow up. Both were great - especially when delivering the news that we had one boy and one girl guinea pig (both were supposed to be boys) and both had ringworm (PSA do not buy your guinea pigs at Petsmart). Our second visit included a thorough exam of Lola to confirm she was not pregnant 🙏🏻.

While the prices of care did cause me to do a double take, I appreciated the exotic specialty and didn’t feel rushed at any point during my visit. Since these are my first guinea pigs more than 30 years and they’ve come with surprises (the bad kind), I appreciated the extra time and advice to make them happy and healthy.

I was recommended to Animal House by a friend, and it is close to my home. The Vet care was good, people were kind, but communication and follow up need to be improved. I appreciated that they were able to get me in same day for an urgent dental matter with my dog, after I found out that my usual vet is retiring and closing their practice. The vet that we saw (Dr. Ivankovig) was very thorough and helpful, and advised that my dog would need a dental and potentially extractions. I went ahead and booked an appointment for him the following week, and acknowledged that I would need to notify 48 hours for surgical procedures or 24 for vet appointments. I was advised by the vet tech (Maura) that I would receive an estimate for the future dental services later that day. I did receive an email, but it just had the receipt for the services they performed that day.

I waited for the estimate to be sent over,  it never was. I finally had to reach out about 48 hours before the dental service. Once it was sent, and I had time to review the estimate I wanted to ask for second opinions, and price comparison. I reached out 24 hours before to see if I could reschedule/cancel the appointment, to have a little more time to think. I was advised that I would forfeit my room deposit since it was less than 48 hours before. I understand polices- but it leaves a bit of a bad taste in my mouth that I was not given the follow up promised, so I could consider my options. Then painted into a corner of loosing my deposit, because I didn't receive the information I needed to until after the 48 hour window I needed to follow their guidelines.

I will be taking my dog in for the dental to not loose the deposit, but may have to reevaluate in the future-given the lack of communication. Will try to update after service.
